title: Trump's diesel agreement with Putin accused of contradicting Russia sanctions law
summary: The Trump administration's reported diesel agreement with Russia faces criticism from Ukraine as potentially conflicting with existing sanctions. President Zelenskyy contends that easing sanctions undermines U.S. efforts to pressure Moscow economically.
content: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a searing statement that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."

zh.title: 特朗普与普京的柴油协议被指违反俄罗斯制裁法
zh.summary: 特朗普政府报告的与俄罗斯达成的柴油协议面临乌克兰的批评，可能与现有制裁相冲突。泽连斯基总统主张，放宽制裁会削弱美国对莫斯科施加经济压力的努力。
